# Lake Forest Veterinarians

> A full-service animal hospital in Lake Forest, IL offering emergency care, surgical procedures, dental services, and comprehensive pet wellness programs.

Animal Hospital of West Lake Forest, located at 999 Sherwood Drive in Lake Bluff, IL, is a veterinary practice serving the North Shore community with a team of experienced veterinarians including Dr. David McKenna and comprehensive clinical services.

## Veterinary Services

- [Our Services](https://www.lakeforestvets.com/our-services.html): Emergency, dental, surgical, and preventive veterinary services
- [Pet Wellness Menu](https://www.lakeforestvets.com/pet-wellness-menu.html): Pet wellness exams, vaccinations, and preventive care services
- [Emergency Services](https://www.lakeforestvets.com/emergency-services.html): After-hours emergency care and veterinary specialty referrals
- [Your Pet's Surgery](https://www.lakeforestvets.com/your-pets-surgery.html): Surgical procedures including spay, neuter, and pain management
- [Dental Care](https://www.lakeforestvets.com/dental-care.html): Pet dental care, teeth cleaning, and periodontal disease treatment
- [Diagnostic Services](https://www.lakeforestvets.com/diagnostic-services.html): On-site lab, radiology, and ultrasound diagnostic services
